contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (500) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($500) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' ($500), and is repeated at summary line 4 and line 5
contributions.detail: 1 Schedule A row: 500.00 = the schedule's printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 500 (first report of the cycle, so period and YTD coincide) and is NOT summed as an increment. The p2 balance ladder closes: line 3 (a written zero) + line 4 500 = line 5 500; 500 - line 6 2,549.71 = line 7 -2,049.71, a NEGATIVE closing balance printed with a leading minus sign and kept negative.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (2,549.71) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($2,549.71) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' ($2,549.71) and to line 6 of the balance ladder
expenditures.detail: 14 Schedule B rows sum to 484.51 + 64.94 + 29.86 + 334.51 + 104.63 + 30.00 + 204.56 + 109.63 + 616.00 + 50.00 + 49.07 + 392.00 + 20.00 + 60.00 = 2,549.71 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed schedule total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. Column B YTD 2,549.71 is the same figure and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. Note the filer spent more than he raised this period, which is why the closing balance is negative — that is the document's own arithmetic, not a transcription error.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed both sides (500.00 / 2,549.71); the monetary-plus-in-kind convention was tested and is identical, because no row is marked in-kind and this form prints no in-kind column or line.
itemized.escalation_note: Four tight crops at 900-1200 dpi, all legibility/geometry (both sides had already closed on the printed subtotals): p3's single amount box rendered '$500' (a slashed dollar sign, then 500, NO cents written); p4 band 1 rendered '484.51'; p4 band 14 rendered '60.00' (the filer trails the final zero into a dash-like stroke, '60.0-0', but the closure and the glyph agree at 60.00); p4 band 9 rendered '616.00', confirming the largest line. A 1200 dpi crop of p4 band 13's NAME cell showed 'Leg 5' followed by a character written over another character — it is not resolvable at any resolution and is recorded as such rather than guessed.

itemized.notes: legacy_colAB variant on the 2010 blank; 4 pages: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', signed 'June 15, 2010', stamped received JUN 15), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B — the three form sheets carry the filer's own '1 of 1' foliation on EACH sheet (he numbered each schedule independently, not the document), which is why a page ordinal cannot be trusted to locate anything here. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT UNANSWERED on the cover: NEITHER the 'Yes' nor the 'No' box is checked (confirming what the 2026-08-01 cover tranche recorded) — an honest blank, not a failed read. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A figures. The closing balance is NEGATIVE (-2,049.71), printed with a leading minus sign and kept negative; the filer spent 2,549.71 against 500.00 raised, so this report on its face does not fund itself — the document's own arithmetic, transcribed, not adjudicated. PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'Kris Poulson' (signing 'Kris W. Poulson'; Republican, residence city Payson) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row; the page-face Office Seeking line reads simply 'Assessor', which agrees with index.csv's 'County Assessor'. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — published in the clear; the donor's street line was visible and only city was carried, at READ TIME.
